quotations.old_english: Slagen mid sæmnedlicre (semnendlicre, v. l.) blindnesse
In þǽre fǽrlican (symnenlican and fǽrlican, v. l.) wafunge

source_text: semnend(-ed)-lic; adj. Sudden :-- Slagen mid sæmnedlicre (semnendlicre, v. l.) blindnesse subita caecitate percussus, Gr. D. 235, 3. In þǽre fǽrlican (symnenlican and fǽrlican, v. l.) wafunge in subito stupore, 284, 23. v. samnunga.
